_comment: Gate 0 pre-registration precondition 3 (reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md) -- the readiness_dev-mode source-pins manifest eval/score_gate0.py::SOURCE_PIN_FILES['readiness_dev'] expects. Binds the DEV-seed (0..4) rehearsal mode to hash-pinned expected-pins files, per-arm audit evidence LOCATIONS (not content -- content is per-attempt and does not exist pre-run), and the six named metric/proof artifacts _verify_sources() reads. See eval/fixtures/gate0_expected_pins.SOURCES.md for field-by-field sourcing. red_human/miniwob_agent/etc. paths that do not exist yet are intentional forward pointers, not fabricated content (INDEPENDENCE LAW) -- eval/score_gate0.py correctly reports 'source_unreadable:<key>' for each until the owning workstream lands (precondition 6 human baselines: PR #116, ships the rig only, not the numbers; wake-boundary accounting and the paid/dev agent attempts themselves: still open, out of this PR's scope per reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md preconditions 3+4 only). live_breaker is the one exception: it is real, produced by this PR (precondition 4) -- see reports/2026-07-19-gate0-live-breaker-dry-run.md.
_source_frozen_seed_sha256: sha256 of eval/fixtures/gate0_miniwob_dev_seeds.json ([0,1,2,3,4]) as committed on this branch, matching eval.score_gate0.MODES['readiness_dev'][0]. This is the hash of the LF-canonical bytes (identical to the git blob): .gitattributes pins eval/fixtures/gate0_*.json to eol=lf so every checkout on every platform materializes these exact bytes -- without that, a Windows autocrlf=true checkout would materialize CRLF and this pin would be non-portable (the same trap PR #114 fixed for host_code_sha256).
_source_artifact_paths: red_human/miniwob_human: exact paths named by DAVID_BASELINES.md ('Where a future scorer will point', PR #116) -- coordinated, not invented. red_agent/miniwob_agent/wake_boundary: not yet produced by any workstream (agent attempt + wake-accounting are open items outside preconditions 3+4); paths chosen to mirror the same runs/gate0_readiness_dev/<arm>/ layout tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1's OutputDir convention would naturally produce. live_breaker: real, produced by tools/gate0_credit_breaker.py's synthetic dry run this PR ships (precondition 4).
_source_artifact_sha256: Placeholders for the five not-yet-existing artifacts are inert by construction: eval.score_gate0._verify_sources() hits FileNotFoundError reading the path before it ever compares this hash, so these strings are never actually checked -- they exist only so the JSON key is present and self-documenting (never a valid 64-hex sha256, so they can never accidentally satisfy the check either). live_breaker's hash is REAL and DETERMINISTIC (PR #118 pins review MINOR 1 fix): the artifact contains no wall-clock timestamp and is written LF-forced, so its bytes are a pure function of tools/gate0_credit_breaker.py's committed code -- anyone can regenerate runs/gate0_live_breaker/live_breaker_dry_run_trip.json on any platform (`uv run --frozen python tools/gate0_credit_breaker.py dry-run-synthetic --out <path>`) and reproduce exactly this hash; see reports/2026-07-19-gate0-live-breaker-dry-run.md.
_source_audit_paths: artifacts_dir/transcript/receipt/oracle layout mirrors tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1's own OutputDir/launch/world contract (lines 179-184, 400) so a real launch with -OutputDir runs/gate0_readiness_dev/<arm> lines up with these pins with zero renaming. expected_pins point at this PR's two frozen files (hash-pinned below via expected_pins_sha256, per eval.score_gate0._verify_audit_paths()'s own requirement).
_source_expected_pins_sha256: sha256 of eval/fixtures/gate0_expected_pins_red.json / gate0_expected_pins_miniwob.json exactly as committed on this branch -- recompute if either file is edited.
